title: A picture fix round keeps every frame the picker does not change as the earlier rounds finished it
steps: S1: In the TCH checkout with dependencies installed, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm every test named in run.tests reports ok.
expect: A fix round changing one frame's photo makes only that frame and its twin again; every other frame, wait, return, row and rung stays.
A later finish of a finished manifest draws, looks and climbs nothing again.

tests: a fix round makes again only the frame whose photo changes; every other frame keeps what it finished
round 0 (no finished manifest before it) is made from the code half as before
the ladder state reads the rows a manifest dropped and the rungs it took, and drops further rows from what is left
a later round keeps the picture an earlier ladder kept as its best rejected one: no rung, draw or look again
